end.summary:
Practised identifying cube, cuboid, cylinder, cone and sphere in toys and objects.
Aditya correctly named dice as a cube, candle as a cylinder, party cap as a cone, ball as a sphere, and rocket as a cylinder.
Aditya counted two flat faces for a cylinder.
Aditya called pencil boxes and bricks cubes because they are box-shaped; this mix-up was not corrected by the end.
Teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Asha practised finding 3D shapes in familiar objects and counting flat faces. Aditya used useful examples such as a candle for a cylinder, a party cap for a cone, and a ball for a sphere. They mixed up cubes and cuboids by treating every box as a cube, and this was not corrected later in the lesson. At home, show a dice, a brick, and a pencil box together and ask whether all faces are equal squares or rectangular faces.
